concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-testing-go-live-node]] - Braintree Node.js route for sandbox recurring-billing setup and test-value locators, plus the separate production credentials, recreated settings and plans, environment switch, and limited real-payment settlement checks
warnings: Keep sandbox simulations separate from production behavior; the source explicitly says sandbox objects, settings and credentials do not transfer.
Do not copy nonce, CVV or 3D Secure value tables into the concept; route those routine values to the source's exact raw locators.
Preserve the production warning that real payment methods, debits and fees apply to settled tests.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-recurring-billing-testing-go-live-node]] - Node.js recurring-billing testing and production-transition route covering isolated credentials and settings, server-side production configuration, the client-token boundary, and real-payment production-test warnings
warnings: Preserve the Node.js and recurring-billing scope; do not generalize this guide into current enablement for every merchant or payment method.
The no-client-configuration-update statement is specifically tied to a client obtaining its token from the server during this production switch.
Do not treat similarity between live and sandbox after configuration as equivalence or as proof of production settlement.
